question: What is the synonym of 'mellifluous'?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mellifluous"** means sweet-sounding or pleasant to hear. (मधुर स्वर)

 
 
• **Example:** The singer's mellifluous voice captivated the entire audience.
 
 
 
• **"Dulcet"** is a synonym of "mellifluous," meaning melodious, soothing, or pleasing to the ear. (सुगम/मधुर)
 
 
• **Example:** The dulcet tones of the piano made the evening truly enchanting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'mellifluous'** is **'dulcet'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bland** (निर्जीव/रसहीन): Lacking strong features or characteristics; uninteresting.

 
 
• **Example:** The soup was bland and needed more seasoning.
 
 
 
• **Conspire** (साज़िश करना): To make secret plans jointly to commit an unlawful or harmful act.
 
 
• **Example:** The two officials conspired to leak confidential information.
 
 
 
• **Obnoxious** (अत्यंत अप्रिय): Extremely unpleasant or offensive.
 
 
• **Example:** His obnoxious behavior annoyed everyone at the party.
